title: A test helper
hints: Without `t.Helper()`, every failure is reported at the `t.Errorf` line *inside* the helper. Six different failures would all point at the same line, and you could not tell which case failed.

The helper body is three lines: `t.Helper()`, then `if got != want { t.Errorf(...) }`. For the cases, think about what each bug could get wrong: lowercase input, one word, three words, extra spaces, a first letter that is more than one byte (`é`).
